buyer_claim: The credenza was supposedly delivered to my office building's loading dock on January 19th but I was traveling for work that entire week. When I returned on January 22nd, the loading dock area had nothing. No one at my office signed for it and our office manager has no record of a furniture delivery.
seller_response: The freight carrier delivered the credenza to the business address on the order. They took a photo of it on the loading dock. The buyer chose a business delivery address — we can't control what happens after the carrier completes delivery.
